evidence.observation: H701 temperature reads 446.2 °C, markedly above the other reboiler heater and vessel temperatures.
T701 remains exceptionally high at 449.4 °C versus T702 at 70.4 °C and T703 at 77.4 °C; the persistent discrepancy warrants verification of actual overheating versus a measurement fault.

System pressure is 499.6 mbar, column differential pressure 0.6 mbar, buffer differential pressure 2.8 mbar, and cooling-water flow 5.9; no sustained pressure escalation accompanies the high T701 reading.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature measurement, heater power and setpoint, permissible heater temperature limits, and sensor diagnostics are needed to distinguish overheating from sensor error; composition measurements and the separation target are needed to evaluate separation.
